svg.aria-label: Implement and Verify: one session builds the slices in order, test first, and fixes what fails; then a security review when the change crosses a trust boundary, the project checks, and a fresh agent that did not write the code adds missing tests and checks every point on the running program; what is still open after three rounds goes to Review first
